title: Broadcast covariance contraction and regression yield one full-space physical spectral majorant

statement.quantifiers: Every finite-d supplied bistochastic CP HS-selfadjoint channel Phi with a legal equal-marginal broadcaster B; all selected traceless eigenmodes |lambda_i|>1/sqrt2.
statement.assertion: One finite canonical physical EB Psi dominates (2Phi^2-I)_+ on the entire Hermitian space, including arbitrary slow/fast cross terms.
assumptions: Both marginals of B(I/d) are tracial; symmetrized pair correlations T<=I by a squared output difference.
Exact operator-unbiased finite POVM estimators, not independent/separable broadcaster outputs.
Global HS-selfadjointness; the general nonnormal case is not assumed.

inputs: Legal supplied Phi/B, normalized trace, spectral modes and their ordinary spectral measurements.
outputs: One simultaneous full-space POVM/EB comparator and C4 deficit bound.
interface.precision: Exact limit/existence; finite-depth measurement penalty disappears but no uniform efficient finite-bit compiler.
costs: Initial N0 spectral outcomes square at each binary depth; naive size N0^(2^n).
Depth convergence depends on proximity to |lambda|=1/sqrt2; compact moment limit and Caratheodory existence do not supply acquisition runtime.

proof_mechanism: Randomly measure one of m eigenobservables; operator first moments Ai and C0=mI.
Apply B* to product POVMs, normalize estimator sums by 2lambda_i, preserving every first moment.
Full covariance Cnext=D^-1(C+T)D^-1/2; signed congruence preserves PSD order.
H=(2D^2-I)^-1 solves H=L(H+I), and L^n(C0-H) vanishes entrywise.
Regress expectation of any observable against all exact estimators; beta_i=tau(A Ai).
Take one original-space compact moment subsequence and optimize v=H^-1 beta; the same physical Psi majorizes every observable.
obstructions: Spectral positive-part map is not itself CP or EB.
C4 not sharp C2, no diamond-norm or broader bounded-Holevo conclusion.
Linked full multioutput/specific covariance supplements absent; general proofs not intake-certified.

potential_uses.target: Simultaneous measurement comparisons beyond prescribed observable spans
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct exact unbiased measurements and prove their full covariance/regression interface; preserve physical barycenter and every input-channel hypothesis.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
